title: From Computational Certification to Exact Coordinates: Heilbronn's Triangle Problem on the Unit Square Using Mixed-Integer Optimization
summary: We develop a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) approach for the classical Heilbronn triangle problem, demonstrating the capability of modern global optimization solvers to tackle challenging combinatorial geometry problems. A symmetry-breaking strategy based on boundary structure yields a substantially stronger model: for $n=9$, we compute an $\varepsilon$-globally optimal point in 15 minutes on a standard desktop computer, improving upon the previously reported effort of approximately one day.
